groups.name: spring.setting.admin.keycloak
groups.description: Configuration for the Keycloak-flavoured JWT auth on the admin REST surface.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.keycloak.enabled
properties.description: Strict opt-in flag. Adding the dependency does not activate Keycloak auth until this is true.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.keycloak.issuer-uri
properties.description: Keycloak realm URL. The JWKS endpoint is derived as {issuerUri}/protocol/openid-connect/certs. Must be set when enabled=true.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.keycloak.authority-prefix
properties.description: Optional prefix prepended to authority names extracted from the JWT realm_access.roles claim. Leave empty to use plain role names that match the ACL config 1:1 (recommended). Set to 'ROLE_' for the legacy Spring Security convention.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.keycloak.client-id
properties.description: Keycloak client ID whose resource_access.{clientId}.roles are merged with realm_access.roles into the granted authorities. Leave empty (default) to read only realm-level roles. Set this when users carry their meaningful roles as client-scoped roles rather than realm roles.
